mainTopicBrief: 本单元 Reading 探讨自动驾驶从‘演进’走向‘革命’背后的技术与道德难题。仿写训练精选课文金句，练‘Before 时间状语、Since 原因状语、has yet to’的句式迁移。

items.focusType: Before + 从句 置于句首
items.focus: 把 ‘Before + 从句’ 提到句首作时间状语，先交代‘在……之前’，再引出必须先做的事，逻辑清晰有力。
items.original: Before this evolution in transport becomes a revolution, we must understand how self-driving cars work.
items.cn: 在这场交通的演进变成一场革命之前，我们必须先弄懂自动驾驶汽车的工作原理。

models.en: Before a small habit hardens into a way of life, we should ask whether it is leading us where we want to go.
Before artificial intelligence reshapes every job, schools must teach students how to keep learning.

items.tip: before 从句用一般现在时表将来；主句常用 must/should 提出必要之举。

items.focusType: Since 原因状语 + must 的推理
items.focus: 用 ‘Since + 事实’ 引出原因，再用 must/should 推出结论，是议论文说理的常见骨架。
items.original: Since it is impossible to foresee every situation ahead of time, the system must learn to adapt.
items.cn: 既然不可能预见每一种路况，系统就必须学会自我调整。

models.en: Since no one can predict the future with certainty, the wise plan carefully yet stay ready to change.
Since resources on Earth are limited, we must learn to consume less and share more.

items.tip: since 表‘既然’时引导已知事实，比 because 更适合推理链的开端。

items.focusType: has yet to + do 表‘尚未’
items.focus: 用 ‘sth has yet to be done / sb has yet to do’ 表达‘某事至今仍未……’，比 has not yet done 更书面、更强调悬而未决。
items.original: The moral dilemma of how to ethically program self-driving cars has yet to be resolved.
items.cn: 如何合乎伦理地为自动驾驶汽车编程——这一道德困境至今仍未解决。

models.en: The question of how to balance privacy and safety online has yet to be answered.
A cure for the common cold has yet to be found, despite decades of research.

items.tip: have yet to do = have not done yet，但语气更正式，常用于学术或社论。
